title: Traffic Accident in Irvine Kills Young Woman
seoTitle: Irvine Traffic Accident Kills Young Woman
subtitle: A tragic accident involving a McLaren on the night of September 13
excerpt: A traffic accident in Irvine, California, resulted in the death of 22-year-old Alexis Kramer, who was in a high-speed McLaren.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Rand Spear The Accident Lawyer, www.sacramentoinjuryattorneysblog.com, Orange County Register
contentHtml:
A traffic accident on the night of September 13, 2026, in Irvine, resulted in the death of 22-year-old Alexis “Lexi” Kramer, who was a passenger in a McLaren that also killed the driver, James Wehr, 27. The vehicle was traveling northbound on Culver Drive, near Deerfield Avenue, at high speed when it struck a tree, broke apart, and caught fire.

Accident Location and Time

The McLaren collided with a tree at approximately 12:20 AM, as indicated by Irvine police. The vehicle broke apart and burst into flames, resulting in the deaths of the occupants.

Ongoing Investigations

Authorities are analyzing factors such as speed, road conditions, and other elements that may have contributed to the collision. The Irvine Police Department stated that investigators will examine "all possible causes" of the accident.

Community and Car Club Reaction

Wehr, co-founder of South OC Cars and Coffee, had his death announced on social media by club members. A public memorial will be held at the club's weekly meeting spot, at the Outlets at San Clemente, on September 19.

Support for the Victim's Family

Kramer's sister, Kaitlin Gracie Kramer, created a GoFundMe to raise funds for funeral expenses and the transportation of her sister's remains to Florida, where she resided in Lakeland.

Conclusion

The case remains under investigation, and police continue to collect data on the vehicle's speed and possible technical failures that may have influenced the tragic accident. Meanwhile, the community and Kramer's family seek support to cope with the unexpected loss.

With information from Rand Spear The Accident Lawyer, www.sacramentoinjuryattorneysblog.com, Orange County Register.
